title: A synthetic flow network decision-making tool to identify potential downstream contamination risk in permafrost-bound Alaskan hazard sites
authors: Siona Roberts; Emma L. Verstraete; Natasha A. J. Adams; Sharon Kuo; Michael D. Knudson; Alexandra J. Zachwieja
summary: Work by lab alumni on a flow-network tool for identifying potential downstream contamination risks at permafrost-bound hazard sites in Alaska.
